  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Attribute the cudaMemcpyAsync storm to NVTX ranges.\n\nFor every NVTX range name in the profile, count:\n  - how many cudaMemcpyAsync runtime events' CPU launch time falls within that range\n  - the cumulative CPU wall time of those memcpys\n  - the cumulative GPU transfer time (via correlationId)\n  - also cudaStreamSynchronize counts\n\nRank ranges by memcpy CPU cost attributed.\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3, bisect\n\nDB = \"/tmp/sglang_prof_mini.sqlite\"\nc = sqlite3.connect(DB)\n\n# resolve the API nameIds we care about\ndef name_ids(names):\n    ids = {}\n    for n in names:\n        r = c.execute(\"SELECT id FROM StringIds WHERE value=?\", (n,)).fetchone()\n        if r: ids[n] = r[0]\n    return ids\n\nids = name_ids([\n    \"cudaMemcpyAsync_v3020\",\n    \"cudaStreamSynchronize_v3020\",\n    \"cudaLaunchKernel_v7000\",\n])\nprint(\"API id map:\", ids)\n\n# Profile window\npw = c.execute(\"SELECT MIN(start),MAX(end) FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text='mamba_verify_update'\").fetchone()\nprof_start, prof_end = pw\nspan_ns = prof_end - prof_start\nprint(f\"profile window span: {span_ns/1e9:.2f} s\\n\")\n\n# Grab all memcpy-async runtime events in window: (start, duration, correlationId)\nmc_id = ids[\"cudaMemcpyAsync_v3020\"]\nprint(\"loading cudaMemcpyAsync events in window...\")\nmc = c.execute(\"\"\"\n    SELECT start, end, correlationId\n    FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME\n    WHERE nameId=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\n    ORDER BY start\n\"\"\", (mc_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nprint(f\"  total memcpy events: {len(mc)}\")\nmc_starts = [r[0] for r in mc]\nmc_durs = [r[1] - r[0] for r in mc]\n\n# stream sync events\nss_id = ids[\"cudaStreamSynchronize_v3020\"]\nss = c.execute(\"\"\"\n    SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME\n    WHERE nameId=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\n    ORDER BY start\n\"\"\", (ss_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nprint(f\"  total streamSync events: {len(ss)}\")\nss_starts = [r[0] for r in ss]\nss_durs = [r[1] - r[0] for r in ss]\n\n# launchKernel events\nlk_id = ids[\"cudaLaunchKernel_v7000\"]\nlk = c.execute(\"\"\"\n    SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME\n    WHERE nameId=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\n    ORDER BY start\n\"\"\", (lk_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nprint(f\"  total launchKernel events: {len(lk)}\\n\")\nlk_starts = [r[0] for r in lk]\nlk_durs = [r[1] - r[0] for r in lk]\n\n# Get NVTX range names with count > some threshold and their events\nnvtx_rows = c.execute(\"\"\"\n    SELECT text, COUNT(*) n, MIN(end-start) min_d, AVG(end-start) avg_d, MAX(end-start) max_d\n    FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text IS NOT NULL AND start>=? AND start<=?\n    GROUP BY text ORDER BY n DESC\n\"\"\", (prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nprint(f\"distinct NVTX names in window: {len(nvtx_rows)}\\n\")\n\n# For each range name, fetch its events (start,end), then for each memcpy/sync/launch event\n# binary-search to see if it falls inside ANY range of that name.\n# To avoid O(ranges * events), we sort NVTX events and walk pointer-style.\ndef attribute(name, event_starts, event_durs):\n    \"\"\"Return (count_inside, sum_cpu_duration, total_cpu_of_all_events).\"\"\"\n    rngs = c.execute(\"SELECT start,end FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text=? AND start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\",\n                     (name, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\n    if not rngs:\n        return 0, 0\n    # Sorted merge: event_starts is already sorted.\n    count = 0\n    dur_sum = 0\n    j = 0\n    nr = len(rngs)\n    for i, ts in enumerate(event_starts):\n        # advance j to first range with end >= ts\n        while j < nr and rngs[j][1] < ts:\n            j += 1\n        if j >= nr:\n            break\n        if rngs[j][0] <= ts <= rngs[j][1]:\n            count += 1\n            dur_sum += event_durs[i]\n    return count, dur_sum\n\n# For efficiency, get list of candidate NVTX names (n>=50)\ncandidates = [r[0] for r in nvtx_rows if r[1] >= 50]\nprint(f\"NVTX ranges with >=50 occurrences: {len(candidates)}\")\n\n# Do full pass for each\nresults = []  # (name, n_rng, mc_cnt, mc_cpu_ms, ss_cnt, ss_cpu_ms, lk_cnt, lk_cpu_ms)\nfor name in candidates:\n    n_rng = c.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\",\n                      (name, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchone()[0]\n    mc_cnt, mc_cpu = attribute(name, mc_starts, mc_durs)\n    ss_cnt, ss_cpu = attribute(name, ss_starts, ss_durs)\n    lk_cnt, lk_cpu = attribute(name, lk_starts, lk_durs)\n    results.append((name, n_rng, mc_cnt, mc_cpu, ss_cnt, ss_cpu, lk_cnt, lk_cpu))\n\n# Print totals as sanity\ntot_mc_cpu = sum(mc_durs)\ntot_ss_cpu = sum(ss_durs)\ntot_lk_cpu = sum(lk_durs)\nprint(f\"\\nTOTAL CPU:  memcpy={tot_mc_cpu/1e6:.0f}ms  sync={tot_ss_cpu/1e6:.0f}ms  launch={tot_lk_cpu/1e6:.0f}ms\")\n\n# Sort by memcpy CPU time attributed\nresults.sort(key=lambda r: -r[3])\nprint(f\"\\n{'range':<42} {'n_call':>7} {'mc#':>8} {'mc_ms':>9} {'%mc':>6}  {'sync#':>7} {'sync_ms':>9}  {'lk#':>8}\")\nfor name, n_rng, mc_cnt, mc_cpu, ss_cnt, ss_cpu, lk_cnt, lk_cpu in results[:40]:\n    if mc_cnt == 0 and ss_cnt == 0:\n        continue\n    print(f\"{name:<42} {n_rng:>7} {mc_cnt:>8} {mc_cpu/1e6:>9.1f} {mc_cpu/tot_mc_cpu*100:>5.1f}%  \"\n          f\"{ss_cnt:>7} {ss_cpu/1e6:>9.1f}  {lk_cnt:>8}\")\n"
}

# 重建：nvitop 89% 和我的 18.5% 如何共存

**决定性证据**：

```
所有 KERNEL 行 graphNodeId IS NULL（非 graph 内）: 3,238,242 条，62,469 ms
所有 KERNEL 行 graphNodeId IS NOT NULL（graph 内）: 0 条，0 ms
```

**我的 nsys profile 没捕获 CUDA graph 内部 kernel** —— decode forward 全部走 graph，内部 kernels 完全不在 `CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL` 表里（nsys 默认 `--cuda-graph-trace=graph` 只记 envelope，要 `=node` 才记内部节点）。

## 每 10 秒桶的节奏图（最能说明问题）

```
t(s)    k_gpu%   mc_cpu%      阶段
 0-10    12%     59%          S1 prefill (TTFT) 结束，进入 decode
30-140    4%     74%   ← S1 decode（全 graph，kernel 不可见；CPU 74% 在等 memcpy）
150-200  85-90%  12%   ← S8 prefill（dynamic shape 不入 graph，kernel 可见）
220-320   4%     74%   ← S8 decode（同 S1 decode）
```

对照 nvitop 观察：
- **prefill GPU 100%**：150-200s 我看到 85-90% k_gpu%（只差 10% 是 nvitop 采样粒度）✅
- **decode GPU 89%**：30-140s / 220-320s 我看到 k_gpu% 才 4%，但真实 GPU 正在跑 graph 里的 kernel，nvitop 看到 89% 是对的 ✅

## 真实物理图景（修正）

**Decode 期（占 e2e ~80%，且是瓶颈）**：
- **GPU 89% busy**：graph 内部 decode forward pass（全部 prefill-attn、GEMM、RMSNorm、GLA 等在 graph 中，持续跑）
- **CPU 74% busy**：在 graph 与 graph 之间，疯狂 memcpy（5200 次/秒 → 每 decode round 约 30 次）
- **GPU 11% idle**：两次 graph launch 之间的"空窗"，CPU 还没准备好下一个 graph 的 metadata

**memcpy storm 的真实破坏力**：不是直接占 GPU 时间，是**卡住了两个 graph 之间的缝隙，GPU 只能空等**。

## ROI 重估（修正）

| 方向 | 预期 e2e 收益 | 复杂度 |
|---|---|---|
| ~~CPU memcpy 风暴~~ | ~~5-15%~~ → **5-9%**（只能填 decode 的 11% GPU idle）| 高 |
| Plan A mamba scatter | ~2% | 中 |
| CUTLASS GEMM 再优化 | <1% | 极高 |

memcpy 优化还是**回报最大**（最多能把 decode 的 TPOT 压掉 5-9%），但收益上限不是 15%，是 9% 左右。Plan A 2% 仍然可做，但应该放到 memcpy 之后。

## 接下来的工作

我还是先攻 memcpy。但**排查方法要变**：

- 之前我准备的 memcpy→NVTX 归因脚本**只能归到 graph 外的 memcpy 源头**，这恰好是我们要找的东西（graph 间的 CPU 工作）。所以方向不变，脚本继续跑就行
- 关键指标：找出哪些代码路径在 graph 之间高频发 memcpy

> AGENT

关键发现：

```
copyKind    count    avg_bytes
DtoH        500,108  47 B   ← 典型 .item() / .cpu() 标量回读
DtoD        604,889  45 KB  ← 大块 GPU→GPU（KV 搬运）
HtoD        311,822  916 B  ← metadata 上行
```

**80% 的 memcpy 小于 64 字节**（1.16M 次中的 804k 是 4-16B）—— **几乎全是 `.item()` 风暴**。500k 次 DtoH avg 47B，337s 内每秒 1,483 次，**每 decode round ≈ 8 次**，每次 150μs CPU，就是 **1.2ms/round = 21% wall time**。

这就锁定方向了：**消灭 decode 热路径上的 `.item()` / `.cpu()` 小回读**。

现在给主 decode 流程挂顶层 NVTX 定位哪段代码贡献最多。

> AGENT

目前 bench 流程是这样（`/tmp/run_bench_prof.sh`）：

## 1. server 启动（这一步已经做完）

`/tmp/nsys_start_mini.sh` 里：用 **nsys 包住** `python3 -m sglang.launch_server`，参数等同于 `eval/start_eagle.sh`：
- EAGLE3, spec_steps=2, topk=2, dtn=5
- 目标模型 NVFP4，draft model v2
- `--capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-end=stop` —— nsys 不会在启动和 warmup 时采样，只在调用 `cudaProfilerStart()` 之后开始捕获，调用 `cudaProfilerStop()` 后停止

## 2. warmup（避开 kernel 首次编译污染）

一条 `/v1/chat/completions` 发"你好" max_tokens=32。目的只是让 CUDA graph、triton JIT、cudnn handle 等都被触发初始化一次。这一次**不**落入 profile 窗口。

## 3. 开 profile 窗口

```
POST /start_profile activities=["CUDA_PROFILER"]
```

sglang 的 scheduler 收到这个 req 会调 `torch.cuda.cudart().cudaProfilerStart()`，触发 nsys 开始采样。**只有这之后发生的 CUDA 活动会进 `.nsys-rep`**。

## 4. 真正 bench

```
SPEED_DATA_S1=/tmp/mini_s1.jsonl SPEED_DATA_S8=/tmp/mini_s8.jsonl \
  bash toolkit/bench_serving.sh http://127.0.0.1:30000
```

- `SPEED_DATA_SMAX` 没设 —— toolkit 内会 skip Smax 档（你说的 Smax=0）
- S1 = 3 条数据，concurrency=1，串行
- S8 = 8 条数据，concurrency=8，跑满 8 路并发
- 数据从 `/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/data/speed_bench_c{1,8}.jsonl` **分层抽样**（按 prompt_tokens 排序后等分桶，每桶随机取一条；seed=42 可复现）
- toolkit 内部用的是 `sglang.bench_serving`（官方压测工具），每档先 **warmup 1 条**再开始正式计时
- 输出就是你之前看到的那个汇总：S1 benchmark duration、S8 benchmark duration、TTFT/TPOT/accept_length 等

## 5. 关 profile 窗口 + kill server

```
POST /stop_profile     # 触发 cudaProfilerStop
kill <nsys pid>        # flush .nsys-rep
```

kill 之后 nsys 把文件 flush 到 `/tmp/sglang_prof_mini.nsys-rep`。

## 6. 导出 + 分析

```bash
nsys export --type sqlite -o /tmp/sglang_prof_mini.sqlite /tmp/sglang_prof_mini.nsys-rep
python3 /tmp/top_hotspots.py       # 看 top kernel / top API / top NVTX
python3 /tmp/memcpy_attrib.py      # memcpy → NVTX 归因
```

---

## 现在就是这一轮（第 2 次 profile）

和前一次唯一的差别：**我在代码里加了更多 NVTX range** 以便定位 memcpy storm 的具体源头：

- `EW_draft` / `EW_verify` / `EW_draft_post`（eagle 三阶段）
- `EV_free_draft_kv` / `EV_prepare_for_verify` / `EV_get_mwb` / `EV_target_forward` / `EV_verify_accept` / `EV_post_accepted`（verify 内部 6 段）
- `EI_ai_tolist` / `EI_pyloop` / `EI_evict_mask` / `EI_al_cpu` / `EI_free_unacc` / `EI_assign_pool`（accept 逻辑内部 6 段）
- `ED_preprocess` / `ED_replay_or_forward` / `ED_tree_and_out`（draft 内部 3 段）

这些 range 本身开销很小（NVTX push/pop ~几十纳秒），不会干扰 bench 数据。

bench 跑完后我会对每个 NVTX range 重跑 `memcpy_attrib.py`，然后给出 **每个 range 里 memcpy 调用数 + 累计 CPU 时间** 的表，锁定前三名。

有哪里你觉得不对 / 想调整的？

  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Attribute memcpy/sync storm to the new richer NVTX ranges (mini2 profile).\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3, bisect\n\nDB = \"/tmp/sglang_prof_mini2.sqlite\"\nc = sqlite3.connect(DB)\n\n# API ids\ndef name_id(n):\n    r = c.execute(\"SELECT id FROM StringIds WHERE value=?\", (n,)).fetchone()\n    return r[0] if r else None\n\nmc_id = name_id(\"cudaMemcpyAsync_v3020\")\nss_id = name_id(\"cudaStreamSynchronize_v3020\")\nlk_id = name_id(\"cudaLaunchKernel_v7000\")\n\npw = c.execute(\"SELECT MIN(start),MAX(end) FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text='mamba_verify_update'\").fetchone()\nif not pw[0]:\n    raise SystemExit(\"no mamba_verify_update range\")\nprof_start, prof_end = pw\nspan = prof_end - prof_start\nprint(f\"window span: {span/1e9:.2f} s\\n\")\n\n# Global totals\ntotals = {}\nfor tag, api_id in [(\"mc\", mc_id), (\"ss\", ss_id), (\"lk\", lk_id)]:\n    r = c.execute(\"\"\"SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(end-start)\n                     FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME\n                     WHERE nameId=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\"\"\",\n                  (api_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchone()\n    totals[tag] = (r[0] or 0, r[1] or 0)\nprint(f\"TOTAL  memcpy={totals['mc'][0]:>8}={totals['mc'][1]/1e6:.0f}ms  \"\n      f\"sync={totals['ss'][0]:>8}={totals['ss'][1]/1e6:.0f}ms  \"\n      f\"launch={totals['lk'][0]:>9}={totals['lk'][1]/1e6:.0f}ms\")\n\n# Fetch event lists once (sorted by start)\ndef fetch(api_id):\n    return c.execute(\"\"\"SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME\n                         WHERE nameId=? AND start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\"\"\",\n                     (api_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\n\nmc = fetch(mc_id);  mc_starts = [r[0] for r in mc]; mc_durs = [r[1]-r[0] for r in mc]\nss = fetch(ss_id);  ss_starts = [r[0] for r in ss]; ss_durs = [r[1]-r[0] for r in ss]\nlk = fetch(lk_id);  lk_starts = [r[0] for r in lk]; lk_durs = [r[1]-r[0] for r in lk]\nprint(f\"loaded: mc={len(mc)}  ss={len(ss)}  lk={len(lk)}\\n\")\n\n# Collect all NVTX ranges with n>=50\nnvtx_rows = c.execute(\"\"\"\n    SELECT text, COUNT(*), SUM(end-start), AVG(end-start)\n    FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text IS NOT NULL AND start>=? AND start<=?\n    GROUP BY text HAVING COUNT(*)>=50\n    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC\n\"\"\", (prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\n\ndef attribute(ranges, ev_starts, ev_durs):\n    \"\"\"ranges: list of (start,end) sorted by start. Returns (count, sum_dur).\"\"\"\n    if not ranges:\n        return 0, 0\n    cnt, dur = 0, 0\n    j = 0; nr = len(ranges)\n    for i, ts in enumerate(ev_starts):\n        while j < nr and ranges[j][1] < ts:\n            j += 1\n        if j >= nr: break\n        if ranges[j][0] <= ts <= ranges[j][1]:\n            cnt += 1\n            dur += ev_durs[i]\n    return cnt, dur\n\nresults = []\nfor name, n_rng, tot_cpu, avg_cpu in nvtx_rows:\n    ranges = c.execute(\"\"\"SELECT start,end FROM NVTX_EVENTS\n                           WHERE text=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\n                           ORDER BY start\"\"\",\n                       (name, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\n    mc_n, mc_d = attribute(ranges, mc_starts, mc_durs)\n    ss_n, ss_d = attribute(ranges, ss_starts, ss_durs)\n    lk_n, lk_d = attribute(ranges, lk_starts, lk_durs)\n    results.append((name, n_rng, tot_cpu, mc_n, mc_d, ss_n, ss_d, lk_n, lk_d))\n\n# Sort by memcpy cpu time\nresults.sort(key=lambda r: -r[4])\nprint(f\"{'range':<32} {'n':>7} {'self_ms':>9}  {'mc#':>8} {'mc_ms':>8} {'mc%':>5}  \"\n      f\"{'ss#':>8} {'ss_ms':>8}  {'lk#':>8} {'lk_ms':>8}\")\nfor name, n_rng, tot_cpu, mc_n, mc_d, ss_n, ss_d, lk_n, lk_d in results:\n    mc_pct = mc_d / totals['mc'][1] * 100 if totals['mc'][1] else 0\n    print(f\"{name:<32} {n_rng:>7} {(tot_cpu or 0)/1e6:>9.1f}  \"\n          f\"{mc_n:>8} {mc_d/1e6:>8.1f} {mc_pct:>4.1f}%  \"\n          f\"{ss_n:>8} {ss_d/1e6:>8.1f}  {lk_n:>8} {lk_d/1e6:>8.1f}\")\n"

**抓到主犯了。** 惊人地集中：

# memcpy 风暴归因（mini2 profile, 589s 窗口）

| NVTX range | 调用次数 | **memcpy CPU** | 占总 memcpy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EW_verify` (外层) | 34644 | 282,174 ms | **87.1%** |
| └ `EV_verify_accept` | 34644 | 278,292 ms | 85.9% |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└ **`EI_ai_tolist`** | **34644** | **277,581 ms** | **85.7%** |
| `EW_draft` | 34644 | 14,555 ms | 4.5% |
| `EW_draft_post` | 34644 | 5,492 ms | 1.7% |

**`EI_ai_tolist` 这 2 行代码贡献了 85.7% 的 memcpy CPU**（`eagle_info.py:462-463`）：

```python
accept_index_cpu = accept_index.tolist()   # (bs, 3) int32 → 96B
predict_cpu = predict.tolist()              # (bs*dtn+1,) int32 → ~170B
```

数据：
- 69288 次 memcpy（每 round 2 次）= 277.6 s CPU
- **每次平均 4ms CPU 阻塞**
- 张量本身才 <200 字节 —— 时间**完全是在等 GPU 之前的 kernel 链跑完**（target forward graph + verify_tree_greedy）

## 为什么这两行这么狠

`.tolist()` 在 GPU tensor 上 = 强制 sync。而紧邻上游正好是 **target forward CUDA graph**（decode 里最长的一段 GPU 工作，~3-4 ms）。所以每次 tolist 都要**等 target forward 跑完**。

当前结构下：
```
target_fwd(graph, ~4ms GPU) → verify_tree_greedy (tiny) → tolist()    ← 4ms CPU 硬等
                                                         → pyloop (~50μs Python)
                                                         → 继续
```

CPU 在这 4ms 里**什么都没做，纯阻塞**。整个 decode round 的 TPOT 才 6ms，其中 4ms × 2 = 8ms 消耗在这。mini_bench S1 TPOT=6.46ms —— 实际上很多 round 因为 kernel 可以重叠，只吃到其中一个 4ms；但累计下来仍然主导。

## 附赠发现

- `EV_free_draft_kv` sync 累计 15.6 s（2.7% e2e）—— `allocator.free(out_cache_loc)` 触发的同步
- `alloc_sparse_new_positions` sync 4.9 s —— 之前批量化 fix 留下的同步
- 这些都是 memcpy storm 的"次级"来源

## 修复方案

**Plan：消除 `accept_index.tolist() + predict.tolist()` 的同步阻塞**

最干净的 3 步走：

### Step 1：**合并 2 个 memcpy 为 1 个**（快速提速 ~1-2%）

```python
# 把 accept_index 展平 + predict 前若干位拼成一个小 tensor
fused = torch.cat([accept_index.flatten(), predict])   # 还在 GPU
fused_cpu = fused.cpu()   # 一次 DtoH
ai_sz = accept_index.numel()
accept_index_cpu = fused_cpu[:ai_sz].view_as(accept_index).tolist()
predict_cpu = fused_cpu[ai_sz:].tolist()
```
两个 sync 变一个，但 sync 本身还是要等 GPU。省一半 launch overhead。

### Step 2：**pinned memory + 预先发射非阻塞 copy**

```python
# 在 __init__ / init_cuda_graph_state 里预分配
self._fused_pinned = torch.empty(MAX_AI_NUMEL + MAX_PREDICT_NUMEL, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True)

# verify_tree_greedy 后立刻（不延迟）发异步 copy：
self._fused_pinned.narrow(0, 0, ai_sz).copy_(accept_index.flatten(), non_blocking=True)
self._fused_pinned.narrow(0, ai_sz, pd_sz).copy_(predict, non_blocking=True)

# 期间 CPU 可以做 req.spec_verify_ct++ / grammar 状态等无关工作
# 真正用到时才 sync：
torch.cuda.current_stream().synchronize()   # 或用 event wait
accept_index_cpu = self._fused_pinned[:ai_sz].view(...).tolist()
```

pinned memory 让 CUDA 用 DMA 引擎做真正异步 DtoH，不占 CPU。**每次 DtoH 本身从 4ms CPU 阻塞 → <10μs CPU + 并行 GPU→Host 传输**。省的不是带宽，是 CPU 阻塞时间。

### Step 3：**把 sync 推到能 overlap 更多 CPU 工作的地方**

更激进：把 `_alloc_sparse_for_new_positions`、`_mamba_verify_update` 等**不依赖 accept_index_cpu** 的工作挪到 sync 之前，真正让 CPU 和 GPU 并行。

## 预期总收益

- Step 1 单独：~1-2% e2e
- Step 2 叠加：~3-6% e2e（从 TPOT 里省出 2-4 ms）
- Step 3 叠加：~5-8% e2e（取决于重排能容纳多少 CPU 工作）

## 要我开始 coding 吗？

我建议**先做 Step 1 + Step 2 一起**，这两步语义等价、风险低、好验证。Step 3 涉及重排代码，风险高，等 1+2 验证有效再决定。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# =============================================================
# mini_bench.sh — 快速速度验证（全量 bench 的 ~25%）
#
# 用法:
#   bash bench/mini_bench.sh [API_BASE] [N_S1] [N_S8] [N_SMAX]
#
# 默认值:
#   API_BASE = http://127.0.0.1:30000
#   N_S1=3  N_S8=8  N_SMAX=16
#
# S8=8 恰好一个满批，能体现并发压力；Smax=16 覆盖长尾。
# 数据集嵌套关系: S1(8) ⊆ S8(24) ⊆ Smax(64)，每档样本唯一。
# 本脚本取各档前 N 条，保留与全量相同的长尾特性。
# =============================================================

API_BASE="${1:-http://127.0.0.1:30000}"
N_S1="${2:-8}"
N_S8="${3:-24}"
N_SMAX="${4:-64}"

BENCH_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DATA_DIR="${BENCH_DIR}/data"
TOOLKIT_BENCH="${BENCH_DIR}/../toolkit/bench_serving.sh"

echo "=========================================================="
echo "  mini_bench  S1=${N_S1}  S8=${N_S8}  Smax=${N_SMAX}"
echo "  API: ${API_BASE}"
echo "=========================================================="

# 分层抽样到 /tmp（按 prompt_tokens 分布均匀取样，避免前段全是短请求）
S1_MINI="/tmp/mini_s1.jsonl"
S8_MINI="/tmp/mini_s8.jsonl"
SMAX_MINI="/tmp/mini_smax.jsonl"

python3 - <<PY
import json, random

SEED = 42

def stratified_sample(src, dst, n):
    if n <= 0:
        open(dst, 'w').close()  # empty file
        return
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    items = [json.loads(l) for l in open(src)]
    items.sort(key=lambda x: x['prompt_tokens'])
    step = len(items) / n
    sampled = [rng.choice(items[int(i*step):int((i+1)*step) or len(items)]) for i in range(n)]
    with open(dst, 'w') as f:
        for it in sampled:
            f.write(json.dumps(it, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
    pts = [it['prompt_tokens'] for it in sampled]
    print(f"  {dst}: n={n}, prompt avg={sum(pts)//n}, min={min(pts)}, max={max(pts)}")

stratified_sample("${DATA_DIR}/speed_bench_c1.jsonl",         "${S1_MINI}",   ${N_S1})
stratified_sample("${DATA_DIR}/speed_bench_c8.jsonl",         "${S8_MINI}",   ${N_S8})
stratified_sample("${DATA_DIR}/speed_bench_cunlimited.jsonl", "${SMAX_MINI}", ${N_SMAX})
PY

echo "  抽样完成: S1=${N_S1}条  S8=${N_S8}条  Smax=${N_SMAX}条"
echo ""

SPEED_DATA_S1="${S1_MINI}" \
SPEED_DATA_S8="${S8_MINI}" \
SPEED_DATA_SMAX="${SMAX_MINI}" \
bash "${TOOLKIT_BENCH}" "${API_BASE}"

310	**教训**（重中之重）：
311	- **NVTX range + CUDA 异步的时序陷阱**：NVTX push/pop 只标 CPU 时间窗；CUDA kernel 的 GPU end-time 可能在 launch 之后几 ms。用 GPU end-time 匹配 NVTX 会严重偏移大量 kernel 的归因。**必须 join RUNTIME_API 拿 launch CPU 时间** 才是正确归因方式。
312	- 得出"是这个函数"结论前，先做 end-time vs launch-time 对比 sanity check —— 两者 top range 若差异巨大说明有时序污染
313	- CUDA graph `graphId` 列一次性排除"卡在 graph 里"的假设，比继续加 NVTX 高效
314	- 优化 GEMM backend 之前应先 kernel-level profile 确认大头（原结论仍然成立）
315	- **SALA 特有性这次表现为**：GLA 被归到 `MambaAttnBackendBase` 的 verify 后处理路径，命中 sglang 为通用 Mamba 写的 3D fancy scatter，不是 SALA 本身的 bug

339	
340	### 结果 — GPU 只占 18.5%，CPU 在等
341	
342	**GPU top（337s profile 窗口占比）**：
343	
344	| kernel | calls | GPU ms | %e2e | 备注 |
345	|---|---|---|---|---|
346	| `cutlass::device_kernel`（NVFP4 GEMM） | 15,510 | 18,685 | **5.54** | b12x 已优化 |
347	| `BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel` | 840 | 11,683 | 3.47 | flashinfer prefill |
348	| `index_elementwise_kernel` | 607k | 6,455 | 1.91 | 5.28s 归 `mamba_verify_update`，1.17s 别处 |
349	| `vectorized_elementwise_kernel` | 543k | 3,717 | 1.10 | 通用 pointwise |
350	| `flash_fwd_splitkv_stage1_kernel` | 752 | 3,248 | 0.96 | decode full-attn |
351	| `generate_draft_decode_kv_indices` | 25,654 | 1,831 | 0.54 | — |
352	| `act_and_mul_kernel` | 3,102 | 1,779 | 0.53 | — |
353	| `RMSNormKernel` | 13,066 | 1,721 | 0.51 | — |
354	
355	**GPU 总活跃 62,469 ms / 337 s = 18.5% → 其余 81.5% 是 CPU 或空转**
356	
357	### CPU top — **memcpy + sync 风暴（79%）**
358	
359	| API | calls | CPU ms | %window |
360	|---|---|---|---|
361	| **`cudaMemcpyAsync`** | **1,416,819** | **212,556** | **63.1%** |
362	| `cudaStreamSynchronize` | 631,088 | 53,818 | 16.0% |
363	| `cudaLaunchKernel` | 3,005,571 | 9,049 | 2.7% |
364	
365	- 1.4M 次 memcpy / 337s = **4,200/sec**，每 decode round 80-100 次
366	- 平均 150μs CPU / 次 —— 名字叫 Async 但实际 **同步等待**（小张量 D2H readback 典型特征）
367	- memcpy GPU 侧总共只有 864ms（0.26%），**99.6% 的 memcpy 时间花在 CPU 等**
368	
369	### `update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify` 真实占比
370	
371	| 子 range | CPU 墙时 | GPU 时间 | %e2e |
372	|---|---|---|---|
373	| `mamba_verify_update`（顶层） | 5,405 ms | 5,577 ms | **1.65** |
374	| └ `mv_prep_indices`（Python 打掩码 + cast） | 3,552 ms | 384 ms | 1.05（CPU 主导）|
375	| └ `mv_main_ssm_scatter`（fancy gather+scatter） | 1,484 ms | 5,177 ms | 1.54（GPU 主导）|
376	| └ `mv_track_*`（interval=256，低频） | — | — | 0 触发 |
377	
378	**Plan A triton 融合 kernel 预期收益 ≈ 2% e2e**，远小于 memcpy 风暴。
379	
380	### 优先级反转
381	
382	| 方向 | 预期收益 | 复杂度 |
383	|---|---|---|
384	| **根治 memcpy/sync 风暴** | **5~15% e2e** | 高（源头排查 + 逐点治理）|
385	| Plan A mamba scatter triton | ~2% e2e | 中 |
386	| CUTLASS GEMM 再优化 | <1% | 极高 |
387	
388	**决定**：放下 Plan A，先排查 1.4M 次 memcpy 的源头分布。候选入口：scheduler loop / spec_info 构建 / forward_metadata 准备 / sample readback。
389

391	
392	- `/tmp/sglang_prof_mini.nsys-rep` · `.sqlite`（323 MB / 835 MB）
393	- `/tmp/mini_sample.py`·`/tmp/nsys_start_mini.sh`·`/tmp/analyze_mini.py`·`/tmp/top_hotspots.py`
394	- `hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py:update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify` 已加 `mamba_verify_update` / `mv_prep_indices` / `mv_main_ssm_scatter` / `mv_main_conv_scatter` / `mv_track_*` NVTX（保留作常备诊断工具）
395	
396	## 9. memcpy storm 源头锁定 —— `accept_index/predict.tolist()`（2026-04-22 晚 II）
397	
398	### 关键修正：nvitop 89% 和 profile 18.5% 并不矛盾
399	
400	nsys 默认 `--cuda-graph-trace=graph` **不展开 graph 内部 kernel**，全部 KERNEL 行 `graphNodeId IS NULL`（经 SQL 验证）。
401	
402	- decode forward 全部在 CUDA graph 内 → kernel 对 profile 不可见 → 看起来 GPU 只有 4%
403	- prefill eager shape 动态，不入 graph → kernel 正常可见 → 看起来 GPU 85-90%
404	- nvitop 采样的是**任一 kernel 是否在跑**的布尔量，在 graph 内跑 kernel 时同样显示高利用率 ✅
405	
406	**decode 时真实物理图景**：
407	- GPU 89% busy（graph 里 forward pass）
408	- CPU 74% busy（**两次 graph launch 之间疯狂 memcpy**）
409	- GPU 11% idle（就是 CPU memcpy/sync 没准备好下一个 graph 的那点空窗）
410	
411	**memcpy 优化修正 ROI：5-9% e2e**（只能填 decode 的 11% idle 窗）——不是之前估的 5-15%。仍然是第一优先级。
412	
413	### Profile 2（含更多 NVTX）: mini2
414	
415	方法同 §8，但在 `eagle_worker.verify()` / `eagle_info.verify()` / `draft()` 里加了 16 个 NVTX range 细分 memcpy 来源。
416	
417	**Profile 窗口**：`/tmp/sglang_prof_mini2.nsys-rep` (488 MB)·`sqlite`(1.26 GB)，窗口 589 s，1.98M memcpy / 875k sync / 4.27M launchKernel。
418	
419	### memcpy CPU 归因（top 10）
420	
421	| NVTX range | 调用 | mc# | mc CPU | **% of all memcpy** |
422	|---|---|---|---|---|
423	| `EW_verify`（外层） | 34,644 | 1,111,236 | 282,174 ms | **87.1%** |
424	| └ `EV_verify_accept` | 34,644 | 242,536 | 278,292 ms | 85.9% |
425	| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└ **`EI_ai_tolist`** | **34,644** | **69,288** | **277,581 ms** | **85.7%** |
426	| `EW_draft` | 34,644 | 264,262 | 14,555 ms | 4.5% |
427	| └ `ED_replay_or_forward` | 34,644 | 242,508 | 14,459 ms | 4.5% |
428	| `EW_draft_post` | 34,644 | 554,244 | 5,492 ms | 1.7% |
429	| `EV_target_forward` | 34,644 | 632,186 | 3,093 ms | 1.0% |
430	| `mamba_verify_update` | 34,645 | 103,935 | 291 ms | 0.1% |
431	
432	（`memcpy` 列的"次数"算的是**该 range 里 cudaMemcpyAsync launch 落入的次数**；同一次 `.tolist()` 内部可能触发多次 memcpy）
433	
434	**`EI_ai_tolist` 单独 85.7%**。两行代码 `eagle_info.py:462-463`：
435	
436	```python
437	accept_index_cpu = accept_index.tolist()   # (bs, spec_steps+1) int32 ≈ 96 B
438	predict_cpu = predict.tolist()              # (bs*dtn+1,)        int32 ≈ 170 B
439	```
440	
441	- 69,288 次 cudaMemcpyAsync（每 round 2 次）= 277.6 s CPU
442	- **每次平均 4 ms CPU 阻塞**
443	- 张量 <200 B，**时间完全是在等 GPU** —— `.tolist()` 强制 sync，紧邻上游就是 `target forward CUDA graph`（decode 里最长一段 GPU 工作）
444	
445	### 为什么这两行这么狠
446	
447	```
448	target_fwd(graph, ~4ms GPU)
449	    → verify_tree_greedy (tiny)
450	    → tolist()   ← CPU 硬等 target forward 跑完（~4ms × 2 次）
451	    → pyloop (~50μs Python)
452	```
453	
454	CPU 在 tolist 里什么都没做，纯阻塞。整个 decode round TPOT 才 6 ms，两次 tolist 最坏就是 8ms（实际有部分 overlap，但累计仍占 85% memcpy 时间）。
455	
456	### 附赠发现
457	
458	- `EV_free_draft_kv` 累计 sync 15.6 s（2.7% e2e）—— `allocator.free(out_cache_loc)` 触发
459	- `alloc_sparse_new_positions` 累计 sync 4.9 s —— 之前批量化 fix 留下的同步点
460	- 这些是 memcpy storm 的"次级"来源，单独收益小，先放着
461	
462	### 修复计划
463	
464	**目标**：消除 `accept_index.tolist() + predict.tolist()` 的 CPU 阻塞。
465	
466	3 步走：
467	
468	**Step 1 — 合并 2 次 memcpy 为 1 次（低风险，1-2% 收益）**
469	
470	```python
471	fused = torch.cat([accept_index.flatten(), predict])
472	fused_cpu = fused.cpu()
473	ai_sz = accept_index.numel()
474	accept_index_cpu = fused_cpu[:ai_sz].view_as(accept_index).tolist()
475	predict_cpu = fused_cpu[ai_sz:].tolist()
476	```
477	
478	**Step 2 — pinned memory + 非阻塞 copy（中风险，+3-6%）**
479	
480	```python
481	# 预分配（见 init_cuda_graph_state）
482	self._fused_pinned = torch.empty(MAX_AI + MAX_PREDICT, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True)
483	
484	# verify_tree_greedy 后立刻发异步 copy：
485	self._fused_pinned.narrow(0, 0, ai_sz).copy_(accept_index.flatten(), non_blocking=True)
486	self._fused_pinned.narrow(0, ai_sz, pd_sz).copy_(predict, non_blocking=True)
487	event = torch.cuda.Event(); event.record()
488	# ... 期间 CPU 做无关工作（spec_verify_ct++ / grammar 状态等）
489	event.synchronize()   # 真正用到时才 sync
490	accept_index_cpu = self._fused_pinned[:ai_sz].view_as(accept_index).tolist()
491	```
492	
493	pinned 让 CUDA 用 DMA 引擎做真正异步 DtoH。**每次 DtoH 从 4 ms CPU 阻塞 → ≤10 μs CPU + 并行传输**。
494	
495	**Step 3 — 重排代码让 CPU/GPU 真正并行（高风险，+5-8%）**
496	
497	把 `_alloc_sparse_for_new_positions` / `_mamba_verify_update` 等**不依赖 accept_index_cpu** 的工作挪到 event.synchronize() 之前。让 CPU 和 GPU 并行。
498	
499	### 复现产物（mini2）
```

/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/kill_sglang.sh
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Kill sglang server safely — 只杀 launch_server 进程及其子进程，不碰 jupyter
# 用法: bash bench/kill_sglang.sh

# 找到 sglang.launch_server 的主进程（排除 grep 自身和 jupyter）
# `ps aux` 在某些环境里会截断命令行，导致 grep 匹配失败；改用 args 全长输出。
find_sglang_pids() {
    ps -eo pid=,args= \
        | grep '[s]glang.launch_server' \
        | grep -v jupyter \
        | awk '{print $1}' \
        || true
}

PIDS=$(find_sglang_pids)

if [ -z "$PIDS" ]; then
    echo "No sglang launch_server running"
    exit 0
fi

for PID in $PIDS; do
    echo "Killing sglang PID=$PID and its children"
    # 先杀子进程树，再杀主进程
    pkill -P "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
done

# 等待退出
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    REMAINING=$(find_sglang_pids)
    if [ -z "$REMAINING" ]; then
        echo "Server stopped"
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 1
done

# 强制杀
REMAINING=$(find_sglang_pids)
for PID in $REMAINING; do
    echo "Force killing PID=$PID"
    kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
done
sleep 1
echo "Done"
```

你问的是深层方法论问题。我先承认 + 仔细拆解，再查权威文档交叉验证。

## 直接回答：profile 骗了我们（以及这是这一类优化的标准陷阱）

核心错误：**`cudaMemcpyAsync` / `cudaStreamSynchronize` 里那 212 s CPU 墙时，几乎全都是"CPU 在等 GPU 完成 critical path 上的工作"——不是 CPU 工作量。** 消掉这段"CPU 墙时"并不消任何 wall time，只是把"CPU 在某个 API 里阻塞"挪到了"CPU 在另一个 API 里阻塞"（或直接变成 CPU 空转）。

**证据**：

- §8 profile：GPU kernel 可见 62s / 337s = 18.5%
- §9 修正：nvitop 显示 decode 期 GPU 89% 忙碌 → 真实 GPU kernel 活跃 ~300s/337s
- CPU memcpy 212s **基本与 GPU 忙碌时间重叠**
- 因此 CPU "memcpy CPU 墙时" 是 **GPU 关键路径的 CPU 侧影像**，不是独立的 CPU 工作

去掉 8ms/轮 的 pageable DtoH 阻塞，换成 event.sync 阻塞同样 ~4ms —— **critical path 长度没变**。我们只是把符号从一个 API 搬到另一个 API。profile 里的"85.7% 消失"是 attribution 的变化，不是总 wall time 的变化。

我查几份权威文档确认这个理解。

# Nsight Systems CUDA API Timing and Performance Attribution

Based on the documentation provided, I can address your questions about CPU work attribution and GPU blocking analysis:

## CPU vs GPU Work Attribution

The documentation does not explicitly define how Nsight Systems distinguishes "time in cudaMemcpyAsync" or "time in cudaStreamSynchronize" between CPU busy work versus CPU idle waiting. However, the guidance suggests using **focused profiling techniques**:

> "By default, Nsight Systems collects a profile over the entire run of your application. But, as explained below, you typically only want to profile the region(s) of your application containing some or all of the performance-critical code."

This indicates you should isolate performance-critical sections rather than relying on automatic classification.

## Recommended Methodology

The documentation emphasizes **NVTX range marking** for bottleneck identification:

> "When you add NVTX markers and ranges to your application, the Timeline View shows when your CPU threads are executing within those regions. Then the Timeline View will also be projected onto the GPU, allowing you to see what activity on the GPU was launched in that CPU range."

This manual annotation approach enables you to:
- **Distinguish CPU busy vs waiting** by marking specific code regions
- **Identify GPU idle gaps** through Timeline View correlation
- **Enable critical path analysis** via region-based observation

## CUDA Graph Tracing Options

The documentation states:

> "If `graph` is selected, CUDA graphs will be traced as a whole and node activities will not be collected. This will reduce overhead to a minimum, but requires CUDA driver version 515.43 or higher. If `node` is selected, node activities will be collected, but CUDA graphs will not be traced as a whole. This may cause significant runtime overhead."

**Choose `--cuda-graph-trace=graph`** for minimal overhead when identifying overall bottlenecks; use `node` only when detailed node-level analysis is necessary.
```

# CUDA Profiling & Bottleneck Analysis: Key Guidance

## 1. GPU-Bound vs CPU-Bound Workload Identification

The guide emphasizes profiling as foundational: **"To maximize developer productivity, profile the application to determine hotspots and bottlenecks."** This requires realistic workloads—unrealistic datasets can misdirect optimization efforts.

The document doesn't explicitly label workloads as "GPU-bound" vs "CPU-bound" but provides implicit guidance through the Assess phase: identify functions consuming most execution time, then evaluate parallelization feasibility. Functions suitable for GPU acceleration should exhibit:
- Computations across large data sets with identical operations
- High arithmetic intensity (operations per data element)
- Sufficient parallelizable code (P value in Amdahl's Law)

## 2. Host Memory Transfers: Pinned vs Pageable

The guide distinguishes performance characteristics:

**Pageable memory:** Standard system memory; subject to page faults and OS swapping, limiting transfer predictability.

**Pinned (page-locked) memory:** 
- Achieves roughly **"12 GB/s transfer rates"** on PCIe x16 Gen3, significantly higher than pageable alternatives
- Allocated via `cudaHostAlloc()` or pinned post-allocation with `cudaHostRegister()`
- Should not be overused; pinning is a heavyweight operation and pinned memory is scarce

**Critical caveat on `cudaMemcpyAsync()`:** The guide states this function **"requires pinned host memory"** for proper asynchronous operation. Without pinned memory backing, async transfers may not function as intended.

**CPU blocking behavior:** `cudaMemcpy()` is blocking—the host thread stalls until transfer completes. `cudaMemcpyAsync()` returns immediately, enabling CPU work overlap.

## 3. Critical Path & CPU Attribution Errors

The guide addresses a subtle profiling pitfall: **"When using CPU timers, it is critical to remember that many CUDA API functions are asynchronous."** This creates attribution confusion.

Proper timing requires synchronization before and after measurements: `cudaDeviceSynchronize()` blocks the CPU until all GPU work completes. Omitting this creates false CPU-idle measurements—the CPU appears active when it's actually waiting on GPU completion.

**Key insight:** CPU time spent in synchronization APIs (like `cudaDeviceSynchronize()`) is actually **GPU work attribution**, not CPU overhead. The true critical path emerges only after accounting for this distinction.

## 4. Scaling Laws & Optimization Boundaries

**Amdahl's Law** (strong scaling, fixed problem size):
$$S = \frac{1}{(1-P) + P/N}$$

Where P = parallelizable fraction, N = processor count. Maximum speedup is bounded by the sequential portion: if 75% of code parallelizes, maximum speedup is 4×, regardless of GPU count.

**Gustafson's Law** (weak scaling, problem grows with resources):
$$S = N + (1-P)(1-N)$$

Assumes problem size scales with parallelism, providing more optimistic speedup projections. Applies to expandable workloads (simulations, Monte Carlo).

**Application:** Choose scaling model matching your workload type. Fixed-size molecule simulations use strong scaling; mesh-based fluid models use weak scaling.

## 5. Profiler Interpretation Strategy

The guide recommends identifying the top time-consuming functions first (e.g., `genTimeStep()` at 33% in their example), then applying Amdahl's/Gustafson's Laws to establish realistic speedup ceilings before implementation.

Overlapping concerns—data transfer overhead, kernel serialization, memory bandwidth saturation—require iterative measurement. The guide notes: **"Optimizations can be applied at various levels"** and recommends profiling **after** each modification to verify genuine improvements.

**Bandwidth metric:** Effective bandwidth (actual operations ÷ time) versus theoretical maximum reveals optimization opportunities. Large gaps indicate coalescing issues, suboptimal memory access patterns, or control-flow inefficiencies.

# Holistic Trace Analysis: GPU Bottleneck Identification

Based on the GitHub repository content, HTA identifies performance issues through these key metrics:

## Primary Analysis Methods

**Temporal Breakdown** provides a high-level classification of GPU time into: "computation, communication, memory events, and idle time across all ranks."

**Idle Time Breakdown** specifically addresses your question about distinguishing different wait states. HTA categorizes GPU idle periods into three categories:
- Waiting for the host CPU
- Waiting for another kernel to complete
- Unknown causes

## Additional Diagnostic Metrics

The tool employs supplementary measurements including:

- **Communication-Computation Overlap**: Quantifies "the percentage of time when communication overlaps computation," helping identify synchronization bottlenecks
- **Augmented Counters**: Provides "memory bandwidth utilized and number of outstanding operations on each CUDA stream"
- **Kernel Launch Statistics**: Analyzes GPU kernels with "very small duration, large duration, and excessive launch time"

## Important Limitation

The documentation does not explicitly address profiler attribution errors or methods to distinguish CPU busy work from CPU blocking on synchronization events. This represents a potential gap in the guidance available from the public repository—users concerned about sync-time misattribution should consult detailed profiling documentation or contact the development team through their issue tracker.

# PyTorch Profiler Documentation Analysis

Based on the provided PyTorch profiler documentation, **none of the four topics you asked about are addressed**:

# GPU Idle Time Breakdown and Bottleneck Analysis in HTA

Based on the blog content, here's what HTA provides regarding GPU idle time analysis:

## Idle Time Breakdown

The blog mentions an **Idle Time breakdown feature** that categorizes GPU idle time into:
1. **Waiting for the host**
2. **Waiting for another kernel**
3. **Attributed to an unknown cause**

However, the blog does **not provide detailed implementation specifics** for this feature in the text shown. It's listed under "Breakdown by Dimensions" but lacks the depth of explanation given to other features.

## Critical Path and Bottleneck Identification

The blog doesn't explicitly recommend a specific "critical path" methodology for GPU-heavy workloads. Instead, it focuses on **indirect metrics**:

1. **Communication-Computation Overlap** - Measures:
   ```
   (time spent in computation while communicating) / (time spent in communication)
   ```
   Higher overlap = better GPU efficiency

2. **Temporal Breakdown** - Shows percentage of time in:
   - Computation (COMP)
   - Communication (COMM)
   - Memory (MEM)
   - Idle time

## Key Limitation

The blog acknowledges that HTA currently answers **"what is happening in the system?"** but notes it needs to evolve to address **"why is X happening?"** and suggest solutions to overcome bottlenecks.

For detailed guidance on CPU blocking bottlenecks specifically, you would need to consult the [full HTA documentation](https://hta.readthedocs.io/) or the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/facebookresearch/HolisticTraceAnalysis).
```

> AGENT

查证清楚了。下面是诚实的复盘 + 方法论修正。

## 为什么 profile "大赢" 但 e2e 没动

**NVIDIA CUDA Best Practices Guide 原话**（查到的权威表述）：
> "CPU time spent in synchronization APIs (like cudaDeviceSynchronize()) is actually **GPU work attribution, not CPU overhead**. The true critical path emerges only after accounting for this distinction."

> "**cudaMemcpyAsync() requires pinned host memory**" to actually be asynchronous. Pageable DtoH → 同步阻塞。

把这两条套到我们的场景：

```
baseline:  predict.tolist()  ≈  cudaMemcpyAsync_DtoH_pageable  ≈  implicit cudaStreamSynchronize
                               ^ 这 4ms CPU "墙时" 就是 target_forward 的 GPU 工作，只是"记账"在了 CPU 侧的 API 里
```

消掉 `tolist()` 换成 `event.synchronize()`，CPU 仍然阻塞 ~4ms，因为：
- **target_forward 仍然占 GPU 4ms** —— 这是 critical path，没人动过它
- CPU 不管在 `cudaMemcpyAsync` 里等、在 `cudaEventSynchronize` 里等、还是 spin-wait，wall time 都是 4ms
- profile 里 "85.7% → 1.2%" 是 **attribution 变了，不是 wall 变了**

§9 里估 "5-9% e2e ROI" 的推导也有洞：假设 "GPU 11% idle 是 CPU 慢导致的"，没证明。实际上那 11% 可能是 OS 调度 / Python GIL / IPC，不是 CUDA API 阻塞。

## 方法论修正：识别真正热区的正确流程

### 第一条铁律：profile 别看"CPU API 里耗多少时间"，看 **GPU idle gap**

来自权威文档交叉验证：

| 来源 | 核心指引 |
|---|---|
| CUDA Best Practices | 时间记账 ≠ 真实开销；sync API 里的 CPU 时间是 GPU 工作 |
| Nsight Systems UG | NVTX + Timeline 叠加看 **CPU 区间里 GPU 在做什么** |
| **Meta HTA（Holistic Trace Analysis）** | **"GPU Idle Time Breakdown"** 分 3 类：host wait / kernel wait / unknown |

**只有 GPU idle 的 "waiting-for-host" 这一类，才是 CPU 侧优化能收的。** 我们从来没测过这个值。

### 第二条：CUDA graph 要展开看

decode 全在 CUDA graph 里。nsys 默认 `--cuda-graph-trace=graph` 不展开内部 kernel，导致：
- GPU 活跃 kernel 可见 = 18.5%（错觉：GPU 闲）
- 真实 GPU 活跃 ~89%（nvitop）
- 两个数差的 ~70% 是"隐在 graph 里的 kernel"，**不是 GPU idle**

没展开的情况下所有基于"GPU 闲 81.5%" 的推理都是错的。

### 第三条：GPU-bound 的 workload，CPU 侧优化 ROI 上限 = GPU idle gap

Amdahl:  
- GPU 活跃 p=0.89，CPU-侧最大加速 = **1 / (0.89 + 0.11·0) = 1/0.89 = 1.12×** (**11% ceiling**)
- 实际还要打折：那 11% 里还分 kernel-wait / unknown / genuine host-wait
- 我估我们的 genuine host-wait 可能只有 1-3%，根本够不到 "5-9%"

## 正确的优化决策树

```
Step 0: --cuda-graph-trace=node 重 profile，拿到真实 GPU 活跃占比
Step 1: GPU 活跃 > 90%?
        ├── 是  → 纯 GPU-bound，CPU 侧别碰，打 kernel（b12x 方向正确）
        └── 否  → 看 GPU idle 的 3 类 breakdown
                   ├── host-wait 主导   → CPU dispatch 真是瓶颈，可以优化
                   ├── kernel-wait 主导 → stream 序列/依赖问题
                   └── unknown 主导     → OS/Python/IPC，硬啃
```

## 对这次的判决

1. **我的修复不是错的**，但 ROI 被严重高估。`EI_ai_tolist` 这类确实消了 CPU 账面；e2e wall 几乎没动，因为它不在 critical path 上。
2. **§9 文档需要修正**，把 "5-9% e2e" 这个估算下调并注明推导缺陷。
3. **真正有潜力的方向回到 b12x 路径** —— 那是打 GPU critical path kernel，能动 wall time。
4. **后续任何 CPU 侧优化之前**，必须先跑 `--cuda-graph-trace=node`，量出真实 GPU idle gap 和 host-wait 占比。没这个数，不动手。

3. 回到 b12x：§5 / §6 里 kernel-level 的 TODO 是真的能动 wall 的方向。

398	### 关键修正：nvitop 89% 和 profile 18.5% 并不矛盾

448	target_fwd(graph, ~4ms GPU)
449	    → verify_tree_greedy (tiny)
450	    → tolist()   ← CPU 硬等 target forward 跑完（~4ms × 2 次）
451	    → pyloop (~50μs Python)
452	```

454	CPU 在 tolist 里什么都没做，纯阻塞。整个 decode round TPOT 才 6 ms，两次 tolist 最坏就是 8ms（实际有部分 overlap，但累计仍占 85% memcpy 时间）。

462	### 修复计划
463	
464	**目标**：消除 `accept_index.tolist() + predict.tolist()` 的 CPU 阻塞。
465	
466	3 步走：
467	
468	**Step 1 — 合并 2 次 memcpy 为 1 次（低风险，1-2% 收益）**
469	
470	```python
471	fused = torch.cat([accept_index.flatten(), predict])
472	fused_cpu = fused.cpu()
473	ai_sz = accept_index.numel()
474	accept_index_cpu = fused_cpu[:ai_sz].view_as(accept_index).tolist()
475	predict_cpu = fused_cpu[ai_sz:].tolist()
476	```
477	
478	**Step 2 — pinned memory + 非阻塞 copy（中风险，+3-6%）**
479	
480	```python
481	# 预分配（见 init_cuda_graph_state）
482	self._fused_pinned = torch.empty(MAX_AI + MAX_PREDICT, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True)
483	
484	# verify_tree_greedy 后立刻发异步 copy：
485	self._fused_pinned.narrow(0, 0, ai_sz).copy_(accept_index.flatten(), non_blocking=True)
486	self._fused_pinned.narrow(0, ai_sz, pd_sz).copy_(predict, non_blocking=True)
487	event = torch.cuda.Event(); event.record()
488	# ... 期间 CPU 做无关工作（spec_verify_ct++ / grammar 状态等）
489	event.synchronize()   # 真正用到时才 sync
490	accept_index_cpu = self._fused_pinned[:ai_sz].view_as(accept_index).tolist()
491	```
492	
493	pinned 让 CUDA 用 DMA 引擎做真正异步 DtoH。**每次 DtoH 从 4 ms CPU 阻塞 → ≤10 μs CPU + 并行传输**。
494	
495	**Step 3 — 重排代码让 CPU/GPU 真正并行（高风险，+5-8%）**
496	
497	把 `_alloc_sparse_for_new_positions` / `_mamba_verify_update` 等**不依赖 accept_index_cpu** 的工作挪到 event.synchronize() 之前。让 CPU 和 GPU 并行。

  "new_string": "### 教训\n\n- **CUDA graph + nsys**：默认 `--cuda-graph-trace=graph` 不展开 graph 内部。要看 decode 内部 kernel 需 `--cuda-graph-trace=node`。否则会把 \"GPU 闲\"误读。\n- **`.tolist()` 在 GPU tensor 上 = 强制 sync**，是隐藏的 CPU 阻塞点。小张量也一样贵 —— 代价全在等 GPU queue。\n- nvitop 的 utilization 是\"任一 kernel 在跑\"的布尔采样，和积分 kernel 时间语义不同，两个可以同时成立。\n\n## 10. 性能 profiling 方法论复盘（2026-04-23）\n\n§9 的修复把 `EI_ai_tolist` 从 profile 的 85.7% 打到 1.2%，但 e2e **完全无感**。这是方法论错误，不是个案失败。本节把教训和权威出处钉死，避免再踩。\n\n### 核心陷阱：CPU 在 sync API 里的时间 ≠ CPU 工作量\n\n**NVIDIA CUDA C Best Practices Guide** 原话（profiling 章节）：\n> When using CPU timers, it is critical to remember that many CUDA API functions are asynchronous. **CPU time spent in synchronization APIs (like `cudaDeviceSynchronize()`) is actually GPU work attribution, not CPU overhead.** The true critical path emerges only after accounting for this distinction.\n\n补充原文：\n> `cudaMemcpyAsync()` **requires pinned host memory** [for asynchrony]. Without pinned memory backing, async transfers may not function as intended.\n\n**直译到我们这次**：\n- baseline 的 `.tolist()` 等价于 `cudaMemcpyAsync(DtoH, pageable)` = 阻塞版本\n- 那 4ms CPU 墙时 = target_forward kernel（GPU critical path）的 CPU 侧影像\n- 消掉这段 CPU 等待 → `event.synchronize()` 上阻塞同样 4ms（或者 CPU 空转等下一段 GPU-dep 工作）\n- **critical path 没变 → wall time 没变**\n- profile \"变好看\" 只是 attribution 改了 API，不是 wall 被压缩了\n\n### 用 Amdahl's Law 算 ROI 天花板（也是权威要求）\n\nCUDA Best Practices 章节 12（Scaling）要求在优化前就用 Amdahl 算天花板：\n\n$$S \\le \\frac{1}{(1-P) + P/N} \\quad ; \\quad P = \\text{可并行比例}, N = \\text{并行度}$$\n\n对我们的 decode：\n- 真实 GPU 活跃 ~89%（nvitop），CPU-侧优化对应 \"(1-P) = 11%\" 段\n- CPU-侧优化 **e2e 上限 = 1/(0.89+0.11·0) = 1.12×**，**即 ≤ 11% e2e**\n- §9 估 \"5-9%\" 已经吃掉 GPU idle 上限的一半 → 需要严格证明\"那 11% 里有 5-9% 是 host-wait\"\n- 当时**没证明**，直接写进文档。这是方法论事故。\n\n### 正确的 GPU-idle breakdown：Meta HTA 的 3 分类\n\nMeta **Holistic Trace Analysis** (HTA) 定义的 **Idle Time Breakdown**（PyTorch 官方博客 _Trace Analysis for the Masses_ 推荐工具）：\n\n1. **Host wait** — GPU 闲，因为 CPU 还没 launch 下一个 kernel → 可优化，CPU 侧可收\n2. **Kernel wait** — GPU 闲，因为在等另一个 kernel 的依赖 → 优化 stream/graph 结构\n3. **Unknown** — 其他（OS 调度 / 驱动开销 / PCIe 等）→ 通常硬啃不动\n\n**只有 (1) host-wait 才是 CPU 侧优化能收的。** 我们从未测过 host-wait 占比就直接估 \"5-9%\"，等于空手套白狼。\n\n### 决策树（从今以后按这个来）\n\n每次 CPU 侧优化候选出来前，必须先过：\n\n```\nStep 0  nsys profile  --cuda-graph-trace=node   ← 必须 node，不能 graph\n              ↓\nStep 1  算 GPU 实际活跃 % = Σ(kernel_duration) / profile_window\n              ↓\nStep 2  GPU 活跃 ≥ 90%?\n        ├── 是 → 纯 GPU-bound。CPU 侧再好都 ≤ 10%。\n        │        优先攻 GPU top kernels（走 b12x / CUTLASS / Marlin 路线）\n        │\n        └── 否 → GPU idle > 10%，拆 idle breakdown：\n              ↓\n        Step 3  用 HTA 或手算：host-wait / kernel-wait / unknown\n              ↓\n        Step 4  host-wait 占比决定 CPU 侧 ROI 天花板\n                host-wait < 5%  → CPU 侧不做\n                host-wait 5-15% → 可做，但先验证目标改动能挤掉 host-wait\n                host-wait > 15% → 值得深究\n              ↓\n        Step 5  改完必须 e2e 再测一遍确认 host-wait 真的下去了\n                profile \"账面变好\" 不算数，只认 wall time\n```\n\n### 为什么 nsys \"CPU API CPU 时间\" 是陷阱\n\nnsys 的 `CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME` 表记的是 **CPU 线程在该 API 调用里从 entry 到 return 的 wall time**：\n- 对 `cudaMemcpyAsync(DtoH, pageable)` → 阻塞型 API → 这段 wall = 等 GPU 的时间\n- 对 `cudaStreamSynchronize` → 显式阻塞 → 这段 wall = 等 GPU 的时间\n- **两者 accumulate 的 \"CPU 时间\" 都是 GPU 时间的投影**，**不是可优化的 CPU 工作**\n\n把这类 \"CPU time\" 当 CPU 工作优化 = 优化了也没用。\n\n### 正确量 GPU-idle 的操作步骤\n\n使用 `--cuda-graph-trace=node` 导出 SQLite 后：\n\n```sql\n-- profile window\nSELECT MIN(start), MAX(end) FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text LIKE '%decode%';\n-- 或用整个 prof window\n\n-- GPU 活跃时间 = Σ kernel duration\nSELECT SUM(end-start)/1e6 AS gpu_active_ms FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL;\n\n-- GPU-idle = window - gpu_active\n-- gpu_active / window = 真实 GPU 利用率\n\n-- Host-wait proxy：统计相邻两个 kernel end-to-next-start 间隙，\n-- 该间隙内如果 CPU 正在 cudaLaunchKernel 之外的 API 里 → 潜在 host-wait\n-- 更精确要对齐 stream 和 CPU thread timeline（HTA 做的事）\n```\n\n### 对本项目的具体决策\n\n- `EI_ai_tolist` 修复已 revert，code 回到 baseline（仅保留 NVTX 诊断）\n- 后续**所有 CPU 侧候选**（`EV_free_draft_kv`、`alloc_sparse_new_positions`、`mv_prep_indices` 等）在动手前**必须**先按上面决策树跑 node-trace + idle breakdown\n- 真正可动的方向回到 **GPU critical path kernel**：\n  - b12x（已落地，decode GEMM -32.4%）继续 tune\n  - `BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel` 3.47% e2e，可看\n  - `flash_fwd_splitkv_stage1_kernel` 0.96%，小\n  - `update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify` 原 Plan A triton 融合 2% e2e —— 如果 host-wait 确认 <5%，这是下一个正经目标\n\n### 附：未来 profile 的最低配置\n\n```bash\nnsys profile -t cuda,nvtx \\\n    --cuda-graph-trace=node \\           # 必须 node\n    --cuda-event-trace=false \\\n    --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-end=stop \\\n    -o /tmp/prof_xxx -f true --stats=false \\\n    <server-cmd>\n```\n\n导出后必跑三件事：\n1. **GPU 活跃 %** （上面 SQL）\n2. **Idle breakdown**（host-wait vs kernel-wait vs unknown）\n3. **Top kernels by GPU duration**（不是 launch count、不是 CPU memcpy time）\n\n### 权威出处\n\n- NVIDIA CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide · §8（Timing） · §12（Scaling）\n- Nsight Systems User Guide · Timeline View / NVTX integration\n- PyTorch Blog _Trace Analysis for the Masses_\n- Meta Holistic Trace Analysis · Idle Time Breakdown\n\n### 教训落地（MEMO）\n\n- \"profile 里某 API 用了 X% CPU 时间\" **不是**优化目标，目标永远是 **wall time**\n- wall time 不动的优化 = 浪费工作 + 增加代码复杂度 + 污染未来 profile\n- 改完第一件事是 **e2e benchmark**，profile 是辅助不是结论"
}
```

{
  "file_path": "/tmp/gpu_idle_breakdown.py",
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGPU idle breakdown for /tmp/sglang_prof_node.sqlite.\n\nStep 1: Real GPU activity % (decode window).\nStep 2: Idle gap breakdown:\n    - host-wait    : next kernel's CPU launch started AFTER the gap started\n                     (CPU was slow to dispatch → CPU-side opt can help)\n    - kernel-wait  : next kernel's launch happened BEFORE the gap, but the\n                     kernel was waiting on a prior GPU event (stream dep)\n    - unknown      : neither\n\nDecision: if GPU-active >= 90%, workload is GPU-bound → don't touch CPU side.\nIf host-wait is a small fraction, same conclusion (CPU is fast enough).\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3, bisect\n\nDB = \"/tmp/sglang_prof_node.sqlite\"\nc = sqlite3.connect(DB)\n\n\ndef name_id(n):\n    r = c.execute(\"SELECT id FROM StringIds WHERE value=?\", (n,)).fetchone()\n    return r[0] if r else None\n\n\n# Profile window: use mamba_verify_update NVTX (fires every decode round, very\n# stable marker); fall back to full KERNEL span if not present.\npw = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT MIN(start), MAX(end) FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text='mamba_verify_update'\"\n).fetchone()\nif pw and pw[0] is not None:\n    prof_start, prof_end = pw\nelse:\n    pw = c.execute(\n        \"SELECT MIN(start), MAX(end) FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL\"\n    ).fetchone()\n    prof_start, prof_end = pw\nspan = prof_end - prof_start\nprint(f\"profile window: {span/1e9:.2f} s ({prof_start} .. {prof_end})\\n\")\n\n# ---- Step 1: GPU-active per stream ---------------------------------------\n# Sum kernel durations in window; handle overlap within a stream by merging.\nstreams = [r[0] for r in c.execute(\n    \"SELECT DISTINCT streamId FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL WHERE start>=? AND start<=?\",\n    (prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()]\nprint(f\"streams observed: {streams}\\n\")\n\ndef merged_busy(stream):\n    rows = c.execute(\n        \"SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL \"\n        \"WHERE streamId=? AND start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\",\n        (stream, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\n    if not rows:\n        return 0, []\n    merged = []\n    s, e = rows[0]\n    for ns, ne in rows[1:]:\n        if ns <= e:\n            if ne > e:\n                e = ne\n        else:\n            merged.append((s, e))\n            s, e = ns, ne\n    merged.append((s, e))\n    return sum(ee - ss for ss, ee in merged), merged\n\n# Pick the \"main\" stream = the one with most busy time\nper_stream = [(s, *merged_busy(s)) for s in streams]\nper_stream.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])\nfor s, busy, _ in per_stream[:10]:\n    print(f\"  stream={s:>10}  busy={busy/1e9:8.3f}s  {busy/span*100:5.1f}% of window\")\n\nmain_stream, main_busy, main_intervals = per_stream[0]\nprint(f\"\\nMAIN stream = {main_stream}\")\nprint(f\"GPU active on main stream: {main_busy/1e9:.3f} s / {span/1e9:.3f} s = {main_busy/span*100:.2f}%\")\nprint(f\"GPU idle  on main stream: {(span-main_busy)/1e9:.3f} s = {(1-main_busy/span)*100:.2f}%\\n\")\n\n# ---- Step 2: Idle gaps on main stream ------------------------------------\n# For each gap (end_i .. start_{i+1}), classify by the next kernel's launch\n# CPU timestamp.\n\n# Load cudaLaunchKernel runtime events (CPU-side launch spans) in window.\nlk_id = name_id(\"cudaLaunchKernel_v7000\")\nlaunches = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT start, end, correlationId FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME \"\n    \"WHERE nameId=? AND start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\",\n    (lk_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\n# Map correlationId -> CPU launch start\nlaunch_by_corr = {r[2]: (r[0], r[1]) for r in launches}\n\n# Kernels on main stream with their correlationId (links to CPU launch)\nkern = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT start, end, correlationId FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL \"\n    \"WHERE streamId=? AND start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\",\n    (main_stream, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\n\n# Sync API spans (cudaStreamSynchronize, cudaEventSynchronize, cudaDeviceSync)\nsync_names = [\"cudaStreamSynchronize_v3020\", \"cudaEventSynchronize_v3020\",\n              \"cudaDeviceSynchronize_v3020\"]\nsync_ids = [x for x in (name_id(n) for n in sync_names) if x is not None]\nif sync_ids:\n    q_marks = \",\".join([\"?\"] * len(sync_ids))\n    sync_rows = c.execute(\n        f\"SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME \"\n        f\"WHERE nameId IN ({q_marks}) AND start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\",\n        (*sync_ids, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nelse:\n    sync_rows = []\nsync_starts = [r[0] for r in sync_rows]\nsync_ends = [r[1] for r in sync_rows]\n\ndef in_any_span(t, starts, ends):\n    i = bisect.bisect_right(starts, t) - 1\n    return i >= 0 and ends[i] >= t\n\nhost_wait = 0\nkernel_wait = 0\nunknown = 0\ntiny = 0  # gaps < 10us (launch-overhead noise)\ngaps = 0\n\nfor (s1, e1, _c1), (s2, e2, c2) in zip(kern[:-1], kern[1:]):\n    gap = s2 - e1\n    if gap <= 0:\n        continue\n    gaps += 1\n    if gap < 10_000:  # 10us\n        tiny += gap\n        continue\n    # Find CPU launch of the NEXT kernel\n    lk = launch_by_corr.get(c2)\n    if lk is None:\n        unknown += gap\n        continue\n    lk_start, lk_end = lk\n    # If CPU launch started AFTER the gap opened, CPU was slow → host-wait.\n    if lk_start > e1:\n        host_wait += gap\n    else:\n        # CPU already queued the next kernel; gap is because GPU couldn't\n        # start it yet. Usually: stream/event dependency or driver serialize.\n        kernel_wait += gap\n\nidle = span - main_busy\nprint(f\"idle breakdown on main stream:\")\nprint(f\"  total idle    : {idle/1e9:9.3f} s  ({idle/span*100:5.2f}% of window)\")\nprint(f\"  host-wait     : {host_wait/1e9:9.3f} s  ({host_wait/span*100:5.2f}% of window, \"\n      f\"{host_wait/idle*100 if idle else 0:5.1f}% of idle)\")\nprint(f\"  kernel-wait   : {kernel_wait/1e9:9.3f} s  ({kernel_wait/span*100:5.2f}% of window, \"\n      f\"{kernel_wait/idle*100 if idle else 0:5.1f}% of idle)\")\nprint(f\"  tiny (<10μs)  : {tiny/1e9:9.3f} s  ({tiny/idle*100 if idle else 0:5.1f}% of idle)  # launch-overhead noise\")\nprint(f\"  unknown       : {unknown/1e9:9.3f} s  ({unknown/idle*100 if idle else 0:5.1f}% of idle)\")\n\n# ---- Step 3: top kernels (by GPU time) on main stream --------------------\nprint(\"\\ntop kernels by GPU duration on main stream:\")\ntop = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT shortName, COUNT(*), SUM(end-start) AS tot \"\n    \"FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL \"\n    \"WHERE streamId=? AND start>=? AND start<=? \"\n    \"GROUP BY shortName ORDER BY tot DESC LIMIT 15\",\n    (main_stream, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nfor sid, cnt, tot in top:\n    name = c.execute(\"SELECT value FROM StringIds WHERE id=?\", (sid,)).fetchone()[0]\n    print(f\"  {cnt:>8}  {tot/1e6:9.1f} ms  {tot/span*100:5.2f}%  {name[:80]}\")\n\nprint(\"\\nDECISION:\")\ngpu_pct = main_busy / span * 100\nhw_pct = host_wait / span * 100\nprint(f\"  GPU active = {gpu_pct:.1f}%  host-wait = {hw_pct:.2f}% of window\")\nif gpu_pct >= 90:\n    print(\"  → GPU-bound. CPU-side opt ROI ceiling ~10%. Attack GPU top kernels.\")\nelif hw_pct < 5:\n    print(\"  → GPU idle exists but not from host-wait. Attack kernel deps / stream struct.\")\nelif hw_pct < 15:\n    print(\"  → Modest host-wait. Targeted CPU opt can help, but verify each change by e2e.\")\nelse:\n    print(\"  → Significant host-wait. CPU-side opt worth investigating.\")\n"
}

```json
{
  "file_path": "/tmp/gpu_global_idle.py",
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGlobal GPU-idle breakdown.\n\nFind gaps where NO kernel is running on ANY stream. For each such gap,\nclassify by what happened right before the next kernel (anywhere) starts:\n\n- host-wait  : next kernel's CPU launch had NOT started when the gap opened\n               → CPU was behind → host-wait (CPU-side opt can help)\n- alloc/dep  : next kernel's CPU launch started before the gap, but it took\n               time for GPU to actually start it (driver/allocator/dep)\n- unknown    : couldn't correlate\n\nThis is the metric that tells us how much CPU-side opt can really collect.\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3, bisect\n\nDB = \"/tmp/sglang_prof_node.sqlite\"\nc = sqlite3.connect(DB)\n\ndef name_id(n):\n    r = c.execute(\"SELECT id FROM StringIds WHERE value=?\", (n,)).fetchone()\n    return r[0] if r else None\n\npw = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT MIN(start), MAX(end) FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text='mamba_verify_update'\"\n).fetchone()\nprof_start, prof_end = pw\nspan = prof_end - prof_start\n\n# Union busy intervals\nrows = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL \"\n    \"WHERE start>=? AND end<=? ORDER BY start\",\n    (prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nevents = []\nfor s, e in rows:\n    events.append((s, +1))\n    events.append((e, -1))\nevents.sort()\n\n# Reconstruct merged busy intervals\nbusy = []\ncov = 0; start = None\nfor t, d in events:\n    if cov == 0 and d == +1:\n        start = t\n    cov += d\n    if cov == 0:\n        busy.append((start, t))\nprint(f\"merged busy intervals: {len(busy)}\")\n\n# Global idle = gaps between busy intervals within [prof_start, prof_end]\nidle_gaps = []\nprev = prof_start\nfor s, e in busy:\n    if s > prev:\n        idle_gaps.append((prev, s))\n    prev = max(prev, e)\nif prev < prof_end:\n    idle_gaps.append((prev, prof_end))\nprint(f\"global idle gaps: {len(idle_gaps)}\")\ntotal_idle = sum(g[1]-g[0] for g in idle_gaps)\nprint(f\"total idle: {total_idle/1e9:.3f} s ({total_idle/span*100:.2f}%)\\n\")\n\n# For each idle gap, find the \"next\" kernel (first kernel starting at or after gap end)\n# and its correlation id. Compare correlation id's CPU launch start to the gap start.\n# Load all kernels ordered, plus (start, correlationId) indices for bisect.\nkern_all = sorted(\n    c.execute(\"SELECT start, correlationId FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL \"\n              \"WHERE start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\",\n              (prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall(),\n    key=lambda x: x[0])\nk_starts = [r[0] for r in kern_all]\nk_corrs  = [r[1] for r in kern_all]\n\nlk_id = name_id(\"cudaLaunchKernel_v7000\")\nlaunches = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT start, end, correlationId FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME \"\n    \"WHERE nameId=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\",\n    (lk_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nlaunch_by_corr = {r[2]: (r[0], r[1]) for r in launches}\nprint(f\"launches indexed: {len(launch_by_corr)}\\n\")\n\n# Classify\nhost_wait = 0\nalloc_or_dep = 0\nunknown = 0\ntiny = 0   # <10us gaps (launch-overhead noise)\nfor gs, ge in idle_gaps:\n    gap = ge - gs\n    if gap < 10_000:\n        tiny += gap\n        continue\n    # find first kernel starting at >= ge\n    i = bisect.bisect_left(k_starts, ge)\n    if i >= len(kern_all):\n        unknown += gap\n        continue\n    corr = k_corrs[i]\n    lk = launch_by_corr.get(corr)\n    if lk is None:\n        unknown += gap\n        continue\n    lk_start, lk_end = lk\n    if lk_start > gs:\n        host_wait += gap\n    else:\n        alloc_or_dep += gap\n\nprint(f\"global idle breakdown (window {span/1e9:.1f}s):\")\ndef fmt(x, tag):\n    return f\"  {tag:16s} {x/1e9:9.3f} s  {x/span*100:6.2f}% of window  {x/total_idle*100 if total_idle else 0:6.1f}% of idle\"\nprint(fmt(total_idle, \"total idle\"))\nprint(fmt(host_wait,  \"  host-wait\"))\nprint(fmt(alloc_or_dep,\"  alloc/dep\"))\nprint(fmt(tiny,       \"  tiny <10μs\"))\nprint(fmt(unknown,    \"  unknown\"))\n\nprint(\"\\nDECISION:\")\nunion_busy_pct = (span - total_idle) / span * 100\nhw_pct = host_wait / span * 100\nprint(f\"  GPU union-busy = {union_busy_pct:.1f}%   global idle = {total_idle/span*100:.1f}%\")\nprint(f\"  true host-wait = {hw_pct:.2f}% of window\")\nprint(f\"  → CPU-side opt absolute ROI ceiling = {hw_pct:.1f}% e2e\")\n"
}

是辅助不是结论\n\n### 附录：node-trace 实测基线（2026-04-23）\n\n按 §10 决策树要求，用 `--cuda-graph-trace=node` 重跑 mini_bench 并做 GPU union-busy + global idle breakdown，作为后续所有 CPU/GPU 优化决策的基准：\n\n**Profile 窗**：584 s（覆盖 S1=8 + S8=24 全程）；`/tmp/sglang_prof_node.nsys-rep`（1.35 GB）·`.sqlite`（4.1 GB）\n\n**Workload 类别**：\n\n| 指标 | 值 | 含义 |\n|---|---|---|\n| GPU union-busy | **82.3%** | 任意 stream 在跑 kernel 的时间占比（和 nvitop 89% 差 6 pp 来自 node-trace profile 开销） |\n| 全局 GPU idle | 17.7% | 所有 stream 同时空闲的时间 |\n| **host-wait** | **9.64%** of window（= 54% of idle） | 下一个 kernel 的 CPU launch 晚于 gap 起点 → 真可 CPU-侧优化 |\n| alloc/dep | 0.11% | launch 已入队但 GPU 未起 → stream 依赖/驱动 |\n| tiny <10μs | 5.19% | launch 开销噪声，不可优化 |\n| unknown | 2.77% | OS/driver/PCIe，硬啃不动 |\n\n**关键结论**：\n\n1. **workload 是 GPU-bound**（82.3% busy）→ GPU kernel 优化仍是第一优先级\n2. **CPU 侧优化 e2e 绝对天花板 = 9.6%**（host-wait 总量）。任何 CPU 侧改动不能超过这个数字\n3. §9 估 \"5-9%\" 数量级猜对了，但推理错误 —— 假定 memcpy = host-wait；`EI_ai_tolist` 修复后 e2e 0 收益证明 memcpy **不是** host-wait 主源\n4. 9.6% host-wait 分布多处、每处很小，**没有单点能吃掉 5%+**，碎片化优化的 ROI/risk 比差\n\n**Top GPU kernels on main stream 7**（按 GPU 时间，未来 kernel 优化候选）：\n\n| kernel | calls | GPU 时间 | % window |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Usage: /loop [interval] <prompt>

Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval — or with no interval, let the model self-pace based on the task.

Intervals: Ns, Nm, Nh, Nd (e.g. 5m, 30m, 2h, 1d). Minimum granularity is 1 minute.
If no interval is specified, the model picks a delay between iterations based on what it's doing.

Examples:
  /loop 5m /babysit-prs
  /loop 30m check the deploy
  /loop 1h /standup 1
  /loop check the deploy          (dynamic — model picks delays)
  /loop check the deploy every 20m

> AGENT

这里就是那个经典陷阱的第二轮——"host-wait" 的定义只说 "CPU launch 晚了"，并没有区分：
- (a) Python 在真的算东西（CPU overhead，能优化）
- (b) Python 在 `.item()/.tolist()/.synchronize()` 上等 GPU（是 GPU 工作被归到 CPU 上，**优化后归因会漂移但 e2e 不动**，就是 EI_ai_tolist 重演）

必须把 host-wait 再细分：**gap 里有没有 sync API 重叠**。有 = (b) 假的，没有 = (a) 真的。

另外有个可疑信号：`>10ms` 桶 302 次共 20s，平均 66ms/次——这么大只能是 warmup / 控制面阻塞事件，不是 decode 热点。需要看具体时间戳排除。

写一个更精细的脚本。

If yes → CPU was blocked on GPU (fake host-wait, no ROI).\nIf no → real Python/CPU overhead (real host-wait, has ROI).\n\nAlso print top-20 largest individual gaps so we can spot warmup outliers.\n\"\"\"\nimport sqlite3, bisect\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nDB = \"/tmp/sglang_prof_node.sqlite\"\nc = sqlite3.connect(DB)\n\ndef name_id(n):\n    r = c.execute(\"SELECT id FROM StringIds WHERE value=?\", (n,)).fetchone()\n    return r[0] if r else None\n\npw = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT MIN(start), MAX(end) FROM NVTX_EVENTS WHERE text='mamba_verify_update'\"\n).fetchone()\nprof_start, prof_end = pw\nspan = prof_end - prof_start\n\n# Busy intervals\nrows = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL \"\n    \"WHERE start>=? ORDER BY start\",\n    (prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nevents = []\nfor s, e in rows:\n    events.append((s, +1)); events.append((e, -1))\nevents.sort()\nbusy = []\ncov = 0; start = None\nfor t, d in events:\n    if cov == 0 and d == +1: start = t\n    cov += d\n    if cov == 0: busy.append((start, t))\n\nidle_gaps = []\nprev = prof_start\nfor s, e in busy:\n    if s > prev: idle_gaps.append((prev, s))\n    prev = max(prev, e)\nif prev < prof_end: idle_gaps.append((prev, prof_end))\n\n# Kernels indexed\nkern_all = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT start, correlationId, shortName FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL \"\n    \"WHERE start>=? AND start>=? AND start<=?\",\n    (lk_id, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nlaunch_by_corr = {r[2]: (r[0], r[1]) for r in launches}\n\n# Sync APIs — these are the \"blocked on GPU\" signals\n# Also include MemcpyAsync (DtoH on pageable ==> implicit sync) and cudaMemcpy (sync)\nsync_candidates = [\n    \"cudaStreamSynchronize_v3020\",\n    \"cudaEventSynchronize_v3020\",\n    \"cudaDeviceSynchronize_v3020\",\n    \"cudaStreamWaitEvent_v3020\",\n    \"cudaMemcpyAsync_v3020\",     # DtoH from pageable is sync\n    \"cudaMemcpy_v3020\",\n    \"cudaEventQuery_v3020\",       # polling = waiting\n]\nsync_ids = [x for x in (name_id(n) for n in sync_candidates) if x is not None]\nif sync_ids:\n    qm = \",\".join([\"?\"] * len(sync_ids))\n    sync_rows = c.execute(\n        f\"SELECT start, end FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME \"\n        f\"WHERE nameId IN ({qm}) AND start>=? AND start<=? ORDER BY start\",\n        (*sync_ids, prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nelse:\n    sync_rows = []\nsync_starts = [r[0] for r in sync_rows]\nsync_ends = [r[1] for r in sync_rows]\nprint(f\"sync API calls indexed: {len(sync_rows)}\")\n\ndef sync_overlap(gs, ge):\n    \"\"\"Return total ns of sync-API overlap with [gs, ge].\"\"\"\n    # First sync with start < ge\n    i = bisect.bisect_right(sync_starts, ge)\n    overlap = 0\n    for j in range(max(0, i - 200), i):\n        s, e = sync_rows[j]\n        if e < gs: continue\n        lo, hi = max(s, gs), min(e, ge)\n        if hi > lo: overlap += hi - lo\n    return overlap\n\n# NVTX\nnvtx_rows = c.execute(\n    \"SELECT start, end, text FROM NVTX_EVENTS \"\n    \"WHERE start>=? AND end IS NOT NULL AND start<=? \"\n    \"ORDER BY start\",\n    (prof_start, prof_end)).fetchall()\nnvtx_starts = [r[0] for r in nvtx_rows]\n\ndef nvtx_at(t):\n    i = bisect.bisect_right(nvtx_starts, t)\n    best = None; bspan = None\n    for j in range(max(0, i - 50), i):\n        s, e, txt = nvtx_rows[j]\n        if e >= t:\n            sp = e - s\n            if bspan is None or sp < bspan:\n                best = txt; bspan = sp\n    return best or \"(none)\"\n\nname_cache = {}\ndef str_of(sid):\n    if sid in name_cache: return name_cache[sid]\n    r = c.execute(\"SELECT value FROM StringIds WHERE id=?\", (sid,)).fetchone()\n    name_cache[sid] = r[0] if r else f\"?{sid}\"\n    return name_cache[sid]\n\n# Classify host-wait gaps: real vs fake, and build top-20 list\nreal_region = defaultdict(int)\nfake_region = defaultdict(int)\nreal_total = 0; fake_total = 0\nreal_next = defaultdict(int); fake_next = defaultdict(int)\nbig_gaps = []  # (size, gs, ge, kind, region, next_kernel)\n\nfor gs, ge in idle_gaps:\n    gap = ge - gs\n    if gap < 10_000: continue\n    i = bisect.bisect_left(k_starts, ge)\n    if i >= len(kern_all): continue\n    corr = k_corrs[i]\n    lk = launch_by_corr.get(corr)\n    if lk is None: continue\n    lk_start, _ = lk\n    if lk_start <= gs: continue  # not host-wait\n    # host-wait\n    ov = sync_overlap(gs, ge)\n    region = nvtx_at(gs)\n    nk = str_of(k_names[i])\n    # \"fake\" if > 50% of gap is inside a sync API\n    if ov > 0.5 * gap:\n        fake_region[region] += gap\n        fake_next[nk] += gap\n        fake_total += gap\n        kind = \"fake(sync)\"\n    else:\n        real_region[region] += gap\n        real_next[nk] += gap\n        real_total += gap\n        kind = \"REAL\"\n    if gap > 1_000_000:  # 关键发现，和我上一版假设完全相反：

1. **FAKE (sync 遮蔽) 只占 1.8%** — 说明 9.6% host-wait **绝大部分是真 CPU overhead**，不是 GPU 工作伪装。上次 EI_ai_tolist 的陷阱在这组数据里被 overlap 检测过滤掉了（1.03s 分散，单点不大）。
2. **3 个巨型 gap**（4.2s + 1.0s + 1.0s = 6.3s）全在 `(none)` NVTX 区域，时间戳 t=0.26s（启动）、t=251s、t=265s——这些是 **bench 请求间隔 / warmup，不是 decode 热点**。
3. **17 个 ~47ms 的中型 gap** 也全在 `(none)` 区域，等间隔分布——是 bench 请求序列的 inter-request idle。

把 `(none)` 剔掉之后的真实 decode 内部 host-wait：

```
总 host-wait:     55.28s (9.47% 窗口)
- (none) 请求间隔:  22.99s ← bench 架构产物，不是优化目标
- decode 内部:       32.29s (5.53% 窗口) ← 真实 CPU 侧 ROI 硬顶
```

**CPU 侧 ROI 真正硬顶从 9.6% 下修到 ~5.5%**。再拆 decode 内部：EV_target_forward 2.1% + EW_verify 0.77% + EI_evict_mask 0.60% + EI_ai_tolist 0.44% + ...——每一项都 <1%，**分散严重，单点没有"大机会"**。

另一个指纹：next-kernel 80% 是 `vectorized_elementwise / unrolled_elementwise / index_elementwise`——全是小元素级 kernel。**host-wait 都在"小 kernel launch 之间的 Python 逻辑"**，不是热算子。这种场景 CUDA graph 的覆盖度 / kernel fusion 才是解药，不是逐个优化 `.tolist()`。

> AGENT

所有数据到位，可以完整拆解 17.7% idle：

**"Unknown" 16.2s 其实是被漏统计的 launch API**：
- `cudaGraphLaunch` 9.8s (60.4%) — CUDA graph 入口，我脚本只查 `cudaLaunchKernel_v7000`
- `cuLaunchKernelEx` 4.0s + `cudaLaunchKernelExC` 2.4s = Triton kernel launch

不是神秘事件，只是我分类器覆盖不全。这些本质是 kernel launch 边界，不是可优化的 "CPU 慢"。

**Tiny 30.3s 的真相（最震撼）**：
- 窗口 584s 里跑了 **3240 万个 kernel** = **55,515 kernels/sec**
- 如果每个 kernel 后面有 1μs gap → 32.4s = 5.55% of window ← **和 tiny 5.19% 几乎对上**
- 88% 的 tiny gap < 1μs — 是 CUDA 自己的 launch 延迟下限，CPU 再快也填不满

**17.7% idle 最终拆分**：

| 分量 | 占窗口 | 性质 |
|---|---|---|
| decode 内部真 host-wait | **~5.5%** | CPU 侧可攻击，但分散在 7+ 区域，最大 EV_target_forward 2.1% |
| inter-request idle（`(none)`区域） | ~4% | bench 请求间隔产物，**生产工作流不存在** |
| tiny <10μs 结构性 | 5.2% | kernel 碎片化，只能靠 fusion/graph 扩覆盖减少 |
| CUDA graph / Triton launch 入口 | ~2.8% | launch API 边界，结构性 |
| alloc/dep + 真 unknown | ~0.2% | 忽略 |

**结论：GPU-bound 判定不变，甚至更强**：
- CPU 侧真可攻击的 ≤5.5%，单点 <2%，ROI 太差不值得
- **新的次级信号：kernel 数量 32.4M/584s 太夸张**——这是 SGLang 多流 + speculative decode 多次 forward 合成的天然结果，要想吃 tiny 5.2%，正确路径是 **kernel fusion（把 elementwise 合进 GEMM epilogue）**或 **扩大 CUDA graph 覆盖**，这和 b12x 方向一致（b12x 本身就是 fused NVFP4 GEMM）

668	| 全局 GPU idle | 17.7% | 所有 stream 同时空闲的时间 |
669	| **host-wait** | **9.64%** of window（= 54% of idle） | 下一个 kernel 的 CPU launch 晚于 gap 起点 → 真可 CPU-侧优化 |
670	| alloc/dep | 0.11% | launch 已入队但 GPU 未起 → stream 依赖/驱动 |
671	| tiny <10μs | 5.19% | launch 开销噪声，不可优化 |
672	| unknown | 2.77% | OS/driver/PCIe，硬啃不动 |
673	
674	**关键结论**：
675	
676	1. **workload 是 GPU-bound**（82.3% busy）→ GPU kernel 优化仍是第一优先级
677	2. **CPU 侧优化 e2e 绝对天花板 = 9.6%**（host-wait 总量）。任何 CPU 侧改动不能超过这个数字
678	3. §9 估 "5-9%" 数量级猜对了，但推理错误 —— 假定 memcpy = host-wait；`EI_ai_tolist` 修复后 e2e 0 收益证明 memcpy **不是** host-wait 主源
679	4. 9.6% host-wait 分布多处、每处很小，**没有单点能吃掉 5%+**，碎片化优化的 ROI/risk 比差
680	
681	**Top GPU kernels on main stream 7**（按 GPU 时间，未来 kernel 优化候选）：
682	
683	| kernel | calls | GPU 时间 | % window |
684	|---|---|---|---|
685	| `device_kernel`（NVFP4 GEMM） | 49,665 | 59.4 s | **10.17%** |
686	| `BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel` | 2,683 | 37.5 s | 6.42% |
687	| `index_elementwise_kernel` | 826,622 | 15.4 s | 2.63% |
688	| `vectorized_elementwise_kernel` | 788,645 | 10.9 s | 1.87% |
689	| `flash_fwd_splitkv_stage1_kernel` | 2,408 | 10.6 s | 1.81% |
690	| `act_and_mul_kernel` | 9,933 | 5.7 s | 0.97% |
691	| `RMSNormKernel` | 41,839 | 5.4 s | 0.93% |
692	| `quantize_with_block_size_tma` | 48,675 | 4.3 s | 0.74% |
693	
694	**实操建议**：
695	- **GEMM (b12x) 继续 tune**：10.17% 最大头，且已在做
696	- **BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel**：6.42%，长 context prefill，可看
697	- **index_elementwise_kernel**：826k 次调用，2.63%，融合/消除可节省（对应 Plan A triton scatter）
698	- CPU 侧任何改动前先证明能动 host-wait 里的某一块；不能的话别动
699

    M = input.shape[-2]
    N = int(out_features)
    return input.new_empty((M, N), dtype=out_dtype)


@register_custom_op(fake_impl=_sglang_fp4_gemm_fake)
def fp4_gemm(
    input: torch.Tensor,
    weight: torch.Tensor,
    input_sf: torch.Tensor,
    weight_sf: torch.Tensor,
    alpha: torch.Tensor,
    out_dtype: torch.dtype,
    out_features: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    backend = FLASHINFER_FP4_GEMM_BACKEND if FLASHINFER_FP4_GEMM_BACKEND else "cutlass"
    if enable_flashinfer_fp4_gemm:
        return flashinfer_fp4_gemm(
            input, weight, input_sf, weight_sf, alpha, out_dtype, backend=backend
        )
    else:
        return cutlass_fp4_gemm(input, weight, input_sf, weight_sf, alpha, out_dtype)


if is_cuda() and (not is_sm120_supported()) and (fp4_quantize is not None):

)

+def _load_fp4_autotune_cache() -> None:
+    """Load offline-tuned mm_fp4 cutlass tactics into the flashinfer AutoTuner
+    singleton. Non-fatal on failure — fallback tactic=-1 is always valid.
+    """
+    import os as _os_inner
+    path = _os_inner.environ.get("SGLANG_FP4_TUNE_CACHE", "")
+    if not path or not _os_inner.path.exists(path):
+        return
+    try:
+        from flashinfer.autotuner import AutoTuner
+        ok = AutoTuner.get().load_configs(path)
+        logging.getLogger(__name__).info(
+            f"[fp4-autotune] loaded cache ok={ok} path={path} "
+            f"entries={len(AutoTuner.get().profiling_cache)}"
+        )
+    except Exception as _e:
+        logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(
+            f"[fp4-autotune] failed to load {path}: {_e}"
+        )

+# b12x backend (sm_120a block-scaled MMA, 3-tier Marlin/b12x/CUTLASS dispatch).
+# Fully bench-validated 2026-04-22 (bench/b12x/bench_full_matrix.json): decode
+# GEMM kernel time save 32.4% on MiniCPM-SALA shapes at M=24..256. Bit-identical
+# vs CUTLASS (69/69 cos_sim=1.0 test, bench/b12x/test_correctness.py). See
+# docs/kernels-sm120.md §7.4.

+# Gated on env CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_120a + nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.5.0.dev0 install.
+# If unavailable, dispatch falls through to today's Marlin(≤48)/CUTLASS hybrid.
+# b12x dispatch is opt-in: SGLANG_ENABLE_B12X=1 enables it after operator verifies
+# the weight-scale format matches b12x expectations on their specific quant pipeline.
+# Known gap (2026-04-22): offline modelopt quant produces weight_scale layout that
+# differs from flashinfer.nvfp4_quantize(do_shuffle=False) — pre-permute padded_scales
+# is not guaranteed byte-compatible with b12x kernel input. Accuracy regression observed
+# when enabled by default. Fix path: at load time, dequant layer.weight via CUTLASS ref
+# call and re-quantize with nvfp4_quantize, storing alongside existing scale.
+import os as _os_b12x  # noqa: E402
+_B12X_OPTIN = _os_b12x.environ.get("SGLANG_ENABLE_B12X", "0") == "1"
+if _B12X_OPTIN:

+            MARLIN_UPPER as _B12X_MARLIN_UPPER,

+    except Exception as _e:

+        _B12X_MARLIN_UPPER = {}

105	                         device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)

114	    compiled, sm, sn, sk = _compile(M, N, K, (64, 64), False)
115	
116	    def run_b12x(x_fp4, x_sf, w_sf):
117	        out = torch.empty((M, N), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
118	        compiled(x_fp4, w_raw, out, sm, sn, sk, x_sf.data_ptr(), w_sf.data_ptr(), alpha)
119	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
120	        return out
121	
122	    def run_cut(x_fp4, x_sf, w_sf):
123	        return mm_fp4(x_fp4, w_raw.T, x_sf, w_sf.T, alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend="cutlass")

195	**结论**：b12x kernel 和 mm_fp4(cutlass) 需要 **完全相同的 interleaved（TMA-swizzled）weight scale 布局**。bench `test_correctness.py` 里 `nvfp4_quantize(layout_128x4, do_shuffle=False)` 输出其实**就是 interleaved 格式**（不是我以为的"unswizzled"）；`do_shuffle=True` 才额外加一次 TMA 通道重排。生产 `layer.weight_scale_interleaved`（经过 `process_weights_after_loading` 的 permute）字节上等价于 `nvfp4_quantize(do_shuffle=False)`。

197	**修复**：直接复用 `layer.weight_scale_interleaved`，删掉 `weight_scale_b12x` 占位变量，activation 用 `fp4_quantize`（production-style swizzled）而非 `nvfp4_quantize`。两者在这个布局下 kernel 输出位级相同。

153	def _bucket_m(m: int) -> int:
154	    """Round M up to the nearest benched bucket; clamp to 256."""

161	def _resolve_tile(N: int, K: int, M: int) -> Tuple[int, int, bool]:
162	    b = _bucket_m(M)
163	    key = (N, K, b)
164	    if key in BEST_TILE:
165	        return BEST_TILE[key]
166	    # fallback: scan buckets downward for same (N, K)
167	    for b2 in reversed(_M_BUCKETS):
168	        if (N, K, b2) in BEST_TILE:
169	            return BEST_TILE[(N, K, b2)]
170	    # unknown shape: conservative default
171	    return (64, 128, False)

173	
174	def resolve_dispatch(N: int, K: int, M: int) -> str:
175	    """Return 'marlin', 'b12x', or 'cutlass' for this (N, K, M).
176	
177	    Assumes b12x_available() is True.
178	    """
179	    th = MARLIN_UPPER.get((N, K))
180	    if th is None:
181	        # Unknown shape: keep today's behavior (let caller hybrid Marlin/CUTLASS)
182	        return "unknown"
183	    if M <= th:
184	        return "marlin"
185	    if M <= B12X_UPPER:
186	        return "b12x"
187	    return "cutlass"
